text:
priya: quick note from running the onboarding sample (js-sdk v1.4.3): we observed duplicated results during cursor paging when a token refresh happened concurrently with a 429. repro below.

ken.t: oof, is that the SDK retry path or the app pager?

priya: it's the SDK retry. flow: page request -> 429 Retry-After -> auth refresh kicks -> refresh returns -> SDK retries original request but reuses serialized body (stale cursor) -> server returns next page -> pager ends up requesting the old cursor again and overlapping items appear.

jules: can you paste the minimal logs? even a fake-ish trace helps.

priya: logs (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/list?page_cursor=C123 -> 429 Retry-After: 2
[auth] refresh start (background)
[auth] refresh ok (token new-xyz)
retrying original request with cloned body (cursor=C123)
server -> 200 items 2001..2010 cursor=C124
pager loop requests with cursor=C123 -> server -> 200 items 2006..2015 (overlap)
```

ken.t: sounds like the clone used for retry didn't rehydrate dynamic fields. go-sdk fixes this by re-running auth middleware and rebuilding the request; js-sdk used a shallow clone optimization.

jules: severity? does this corrupt state or just creates duplicates that app can dedupe?

priya: duplicates are visible to the sampleapp onboarding flow, which confused the demo UX and caused manual retries. For customers with strict dedupe requirements this could be bad.

ken.t: quick mitigations:
- sampleapp change: stop auto-retrying paginated endpoints; surfacing 429 to the app pager so it can decide.
- add pager-level dedupe as a belt-and-suspenders.

jules: long-term SDK fixes:
- ensure retries re-run all request interceptors (auth, idempotency token generators) synchronously before sending retry.
- stop reusing serialized request payloads for non-idempotent endpoints; deep-clone or rebuild body from higher-level params.
- add a regression test that forces token refresh mid-retry and asserts no overlapping cursors.

priya: also, logging: emit a non-fatal telemetry event when a retry succeeded but the returned next-cursor differs from the one embedded in the retried request. That would help catch these in production.

ken.t: i'll prototype a PR that: rehydrates body on retry, calls auth interceptor again, and adds the telemetry ping. will include unit+integration tests.

jules: please also add a short onboarding doc note telling early users that the sampleapp may surface duplicate items and the workaround is to enable pager dedupe or upgrade to next SDK.

ci-bot: created issue DEVEX-1498: "js-sdk: avoid stale cursor on retry when auth refresh races with 429" and linked PR draft.

priya: assigning @ken.t and @jules to the issue. thanks :sparkles:
